title: "DescribeLiveSourceTrafficData"

Call the `DescribeLiveSourceTrafficData` API to query the monitoring data of origin traffic and bandwidth generated by specified pull streaming domains or origin streams within the specified time range.

<span id="requirements"></span>
## Requirements


* Limitations: Supports querying the traffic usage data generated by specified pull streaming domains (including deleted domains) or specified origin streams.

* Rate limit: 30 queries per second per account.

* Data latency:

   * When the aggregation granularity is 60 seconds, the data latency is 5 minutes;

   * For other time granularities, the data latency is 15 minutes.

* Data metric:

   * Traffic data is calculated in base 1000, for example, 1 GB = 1000 MB.

   * Bandwidth data is calculated in base 1000, for example, 1 Mbps = 1000 Kbps.


<span id="http-request"></span>
## HTTP request


* Method: POST

* Endpoint: https://open.byteplusapi.com/?Action=DescribeLiveSourceTrafficData&Version=2023\-01\-01


<span id="request-parameters"></span>
## Request parameters

### Common parameters

All APIs must be called with the [common parameters](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/byteplus-platform/reference/common-parameters) in addition to API\-specific parameters.

### Query


|Parameter |Data Type |Required |Sample Value |Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Action |String |Yes |`DescribeLiveSourceTrafficData` |The API operation. |
|Version |String |Yes |`2023-01-01` |The version of this API operation. Current version: 2023\-01\-01. |


<span id="body-parameters"></span>
### Body parameters


|Parameter |Data Type |Required |Sample Value |Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
|DomainList |Array of String |No |`["pull.example.com", "pull2.example.com"]` |List of pull streaming domains. By default, it is empty, indicating that the origin traffic and bandwidth data for all domains will be queried. You can call the [ListDomainDetail](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/byteplus-media-live/docs-listdomaindetail-2023) API or go to the [Domains](https://console.byteplus.com/live/main/domain/list) page in the BytePlus MediaLive console to obtain the pull streaming domains to be queried.<br><br><div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip" data-tips-is-title="true">tip</div><br><br><br><div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip">Either <code>DomainList</code> or <code>Domain</code> should be provided, not both.</div><br> |
|Domain |String |No |`pull.example.com` |The pull streaming domain is required when querying stream granularity data, and both `App` and `Stream` must be provided simultaneously. You can call the [ListDomainDetail](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/byteplus-media-live/docs-listdomaindetail-2023) interface or go to the [Domains](https://console.byteplus.com/live/main/domain/list) page in the BytePlus MediaLive console to obtain the pull streaming domains to be queried.<br><br><div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip" data-tips-is-title="true">tip</div><br><br><br><div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip">When querying the origin stream monitoring data at the stream granularity, you need to specify <code>Domain</code>, <code>App</code>, and <code>Stream</code> simultaneously to specify the origin stream.</div><br> |
|App |String |No |`live` |The AppName field in the live stream URL. It can include uppercase letters (A\-Z), lowercase letters (a\-z), numbers (0\-9), underscores (_), hyphens (\-), and periods (.), with a length ranging from 1 to 30 characters.<br><br><div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip" data-tips-is-title="true">tip</div><br><br><br><div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip">When querying monitoring data for the origin stream at the stream granularity, you need to specify <code>Domain</code>, <code>App</code>, and <code>Stream</code> simultaneously to specify the origin stream.</div><br> |
|Stream |String |No |`example_stream` |The StreamName field in the live stream URL. It can include uppercase letters (A\-Z), lowercase letters (a\-z), numbers (0\-9), underscores (_), hyphens (\-), and periods (.), with a length ranging from 1 to 100 characters.<br><br><div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip" data-tips-is-title="true">tip</div><br><br><br><div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip">When querying monitoring data for the origin stream at the stream granularity, you need to specify <code>Domain</code>, <code>App</code>, and <code>Stream</code> simultaneously to specify the origin stream.</div><br> |
|ISPList |Array of String |No |`["telecom", "unicom"]` |Identifiers of operators providing network access services. By default, all operators are included. Supported operators are as follows.<br><br><br>* `unicom`: China Unicom;<br><br>* `railcom`: China Railway Telecom;<br><br>* `telecom`: China Telecom;<br><br>* `mobile`: China Mobile;<br><br>* `cernet`: China Education and Research Network (CERNET);<br><br>* `tianwei`: China Tianwei;<br><br>* `alibaba`: Alibaba Group;<br><br>* `tencent`: Tencent Holdings;<br><br>* `drpeng`: Dr. Peng Telecom & Media Group;<br><br>* `btvn`: China Broadcasting Network;<br><br>* `huashu`: Huashu Media.<br><br>   If you need to obtain the identifiers of various operators, you can call the [DescribeLiveISPData](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/byteplus-media-live/describeliveispdata). |
|UserRegionList |Array of [UserRegionList](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/24/25091#userregionlist) |No |`-` |List of regions to which client IPs belong, by default indicating all regions. |
|Aggregation |Integer |No |`300` |The granularity of data aggregation, measured in seconds, with the following supported options:<br><br><br>* `60`: 1 minute.<br><br>* `300`: (default) 5 minutes.<br><br>* `3600`: 1 hour. |
|DetailField |Array of String |No |`["Domain"]` |The dimensions for data segmentation are not provided by default. |StartTime |String |Yes |`2021-04-13T00:00:00Z` |The start time of your query's range in RFC 3339 format with second precision.<br><br><div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip" data-tips-is-title="true">tip</div><br><br><br><div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip">The historical query time range is 366 days, and the maximum time span for a single query depends on DetailField and Aggregation. The relationships are described as follows.</div><br><br><br><br>* <div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip">When no dimension splitting is performed or only one dimension is used to split the data:</div><br><br><br>   * <div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip">When the data is aggregated every 60 seconds, the maximum time span for a single query is 24 hours.</div><br><br><br>   * <div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip">When the data is aggregated every 300 seconds, the maximum time span for a single query is 31 days.</div><br><br><br>   * <div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip">When the data is aggregated every 3600 seconds, the maximum time span for a single query is 31 days.</div><br><br><br>* <div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip">When two or more dimensions are used to split the data:</div><br><br><br>   * <div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip">When the data is aggregated every 60 seconds, the maximum time span for a single query is 3 hours.</div><br><br><br>   * <div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip">When the data is aggregated every 300 seconds, the maximum time span for a single query is 24 hours.</div><br><br><br>   * <div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip">When the data is aggregated every 3600 seconds, the maximum time span for a single query is 7 days.</div><br> |
|EndTime |String |Yes |`2021-04-14T00:00:00Z` |The end time of your query's range in RFC 3339 format with second precision. |


<span id="userregionlist"></span>
### UserRegionList


|Parameter |Data Type |Required |Sample Value |Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Area |String |No |`CN` |The identifier for the major region in the regional information can be obtained by calling [DescribeLiveRegionData](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/byteplus-media-live/describeliveregiondata). |
|Country |String |No |`CN` |The country identifier in the regional information can be obtained by calling [DescribeLiveRegionData](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/byteplus-media-live/describeliveregiondata). When filtering by country, both `Area` and `Country` need to be passed in simultaneously. |
|Province |String |No |`beijing` |The province identifier in the regional information is currently not supported for countries or regions outside mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan. You can obtain the identifier information by calling [DescribeLiveRegionData](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/byteplus-media-live/describeliveregiondata). When filtering by province, you need to simultaneously pass in `Area`, `Country`, and `Province` |

|Domain |String |`push.example.com` |The domain name specified when querying traffic data at the stream granularity. |
|App |String |`live` |The application name specified when querying traffic data at the stream granularity. |
|Stream |String |`example_stream` |The stream name specified when querying traffic data at the stream granularity. |
|ISPList |Array of String |`["telecom", "unicom"]` |Identifiers of operators providing network access services. By default, all operators are included. Supported operators are as follows.<br><br><br>* `unicom`: China Unicom;<br><br>* `railcom`: China Railway Telecom;<br><br>* `telecom`: China Telecom;<br><br>* `mobile`: China Mobile;<br><br>* `cernet`: China Broadcasting Network;<br><br>* `tianwei`: China Tianwei;<br><br>* `alibaba`: Alibaba Group;<br><br>* `tencent`: Tencent Holdings;<br><br>* `drpeng`: Dr. Peng Telecom & Media Group;<br><br>* `btvn`: Broadcasting Television Network (BTVN);<br><br>* `huashu`: Huashu Media. |

### UserRegionList


|Parameter |Data Type |Sample Value |Description |
|---|---|---|---|
|Area |String |`CN` |The regional identifier in regional information. |
|Country |String |`CN` |The country identifier in the regional information. |
|Province |String |`beijing` |The province identifier in the regional information. |


<span id="trafficdatalist"></span>
### TrafficDataList


|Parameter |Data Type |Sample Value |Description |
|---|---|---|---|
|TimeStamp |String |`2022-04-13T00:00:00Z` |The start time of each time granularity when data is aggregated by time granularity, formatted in RFC3339 UTC time with second precision. |
|Traffic |Float |`20` |The origin traffic generated within the current data aggregation time granularity, measured in GB. |
|Bandwidth |Float |`20` |The peak origin bandwidth within the current data aggregation time granularity, measured in Mbps. |


<span id="trafficdetaildatalist"></span>
### TrafficDetailDataList


|Parameter |Data Type |Sample Value |Description |
|---|---|---|---|
|Domain |String |`push.example.com` |Domain information when data is segmented by domain dimension. |
|ISP |String |`telecom` |ISP information when data is segmented by ISP dimension. |
|TotalTraffic |Float |`20` |The total origin traffic of the current dimension after data segmentation, measured in GB. |
|PeakBandwidth |Float |`20` |The peak origin bandwidth of the current dimension after data segmentation, measured in Mbps. |
|TrafficDataList |Array of [TrafficDataList](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/24/25091#trafficdatalist) |`-` |A list containing traffic data for all time granularities under the current dimension after data is segmented. |


<span id="samples"></span>
## Samples

<span id="sample-request"></span>
### Sample request

```json
POST https://open.byteplusapi.com/?Action=DescribeLiveSourceTrafficData&Version=2023-01-01
{
    "Domain": "pull.example.com",
    "App": "live",
    "Stream": "example_stream",
    "ISPList": [
        "telecom",
        "unicom"
    ],
    "UserRegionList": [
        {
            "Area": "CN",
            "Country": "CN",
            "Province": "beijing"
        }
    ],
    "StartTime": "2021-04-13T00:00:00Z",
    "EndTime": "2021-04-14T00:00:00Z",
    "Aggregation": 300,
    "DetailField": [
        "Domain"
    ]
}
```
